jobs.title: Operations Associate - Yorkdale Shopping Centre
jobs.description: Summary The Operations Associate at Yorkdale Shopping Centre supports store operations and client service across the service desk, order fulfillment and merchandising. This part-time role handles POS transactions, cash functions, e-commerce and in-store transfers, BOPIS, and on-floor logistics. The associate helps maintain merchandise standards, supports inventory activities and provides occasional sales-floor assistance to ensure an excellent client experience. Responsibilities • Process client transactions accurately through the POS and maintain client records. • Perform daily cash handling (open/close registers, prepare sales envelopes and bank deposits) and troubleshoot discrepancies. • Pick and fulfill e-commerce and IST orders, support BOPIS operations and achieve targeted pick rates. • Support on-floor logistics including markdowns, re-ticketing, re-tagging, restocking and seasonal display changes. • Assist with inventory preparations and counts and maintain overall stock levels. • Provide service desk client support, basic resolution and escalate issues when appropriate. • Support sales floor and ad-hoc projects as required to deliver exceptional client service. Requirements • Minimum of 2 years retail experience, preferably in a luxury environment, in a customer-facing role. • Experience with shipping, receiving, merchandising, order fulfillment and inventory management. • Service desk or client-facing experience with a strong service orientation. • Demonstrated interest in retail technology and ability to use systems to support operations. • Strong multitasking, teamwork and communication skills to manage busy service periods.

jobs.title: Legal Operations Associate, Compliance & Automation Toronto, Ontario
jobs.description: More than 80% of Americans own a car and see it as a fundamental necessity, yet the experience of owning one is stuck in the 90s. Jerry operates across the US and Canada, and our legal team keeps all of it running: entity filings, IP protection, compliance audits, consumer escalations, regulatory changes, and the systems behind them. The team is small, so this role comes with real scope early. You’ll own Jerry’s legal and compliance operations: make sure recurring work is done right, run the programs that need judgment, and keep rebuilding them with AI and low-code tools, so a small team can do the work of a much larger one. The person who succeeds in this role is a natural driver: someone who owns their work from start to finish, solves complex problems without a manual, and has the grit to thrive in a startup environment. If you are eager to sit at the intersection of law, technology, and AI-driven efficiency, we want to hear from you. Why You Will (Or Won’t) Like Working Here • Real ownership early: You report directly to our Legal Counsel and work closely with them across the team’s full scope. You’ll own a set of compliance programs for the long term, and you’ll be the first point of contact for teammates who run day-to-day compliance work. • Room to build: Many of our legal processes are still being optimized. You’ll decide how they should work and build the systems behind them. • Building and operating: Alongside the building, a large share of the job is recurring work: filings, deadlines, audits, complaint responses, and quality checks that have to be done exactly right, every time. Your accuracy keeps Jerry in good standing in every jurisdiction, and people who enjoy both sides of the role do well here. • Growth that tracks results: You’ll learn from leaders who come from Amazon, Better, LinkedIn, McKinsey, BCG, and Bain. Promotion is based on performance and ownership alone, so strong work moves you forward fast. What You’ll Own • Compliance operations: Run, review, and quality-check the recurring compliance work, including entity maintenance, privacy requests, and licensing support. • Marketing compliance and audits: Run TCPA and Do Not Call audits, monitor opt-outs, and keep marketing guidelines current. Check the accuracy of AI-powered audits, and design new audit programs with sampling plans and scoring rubrics. • Consumer escalations: Investigate complex escalations to their root cause, work with Product, Operations, and Engineering on the fix, and turn recurring issues into compliance training for teams across the company. • Regulatory change and readiness: Track regulatory changes, along with issues surfaced by complaints and audits, and see each one through to action. Keep Jerry ready to answer regulator inquiries, carrier audits, and partner diligence quickly. • Legal team support: Support contract renewals, legal research, and product reviews with intake, fact gathering, trackers, and follow-up. • Automation and AI: Replace manual legal tasks with AI and low-code workflows, and own the reliability of every script, report, and AI tool the team depends on. Who You Are • A Closer: You track every open item until it’s done, and you find the answer yourself before asking someone else for it. • A Builder: The second time you do a task by hand, you start working out how to automate the third. jobs.title: Coordinator, Digital Marketing
jobs.description: Job Description What is the opportunity? As the Marketing Coordinator within the Wealth Marketing Canada (WMC) web team, you will be the go-to executor for advisor website requests across the country. This is a hands-on, task-oriented role designed for a true do-er — someone who takes pride in working through a queue, getting things done efficiently, and keeping advisors informed every step of the way. You will support the web team by actioning website change requests from investment advisors and their teams, managing the WMC marketing general inbox, supporting website audits and ensuring every page meets RBC compliance and formatting standards. You don't need to be a developer — our website platform is user-friendly content management too, but you do need to be comfortable navigating websites, making updates confidently, and communicating clearly with advisors about what’s done and what's next. If you are organized, service-minded, energized by checking tasks off a list, and enjoy being the reliable person who keeps things moving, this role is for you. What will you do? • Review, prioritize, and action incoming website change requests from investment advisors, including content updates, page and account set-ups contact changes, ensuring timely and accurate completion within the WMC web platform. • Monitor and triage the shared WMC marketing inbox daily, acknowledging requests, routing items to the appropriate team member, and keeping a clear record of status and follow-ups. • Review all website content and changes against website best-practice, RBC compliance requirements, brand guidelines, and formatting standards before publishing, ensuring nothing goes live that hasn't been properly vetted. • Identify and report potential bugs, glitches, and usability problems within the website platform during day-to-day work and escalate them to the MarTech team in a timely manner with clear descriptions, steps to reproduce, and impact assessment, so technical issues are resolved quickly and don't disrupt advisor workflows. • Coordinate the end-to-end lifecycle of branch website projects, from initial request through build, compliance review, and launch, tracking progress and keeping all stakeholders informed of timelines and deliverables. • Serve as a responsive, knowledgeable point of contact for Counsel teams and Branch management, answering questions about website processes, status of requests, and marketing support available to them. What do you need to succeed? Must-have • Experience in marketing, communications, digital media, or a related field (degree or equivalent experience). • Comfort and familiarity working within content management systems (Yext, WordPress or similar platforms) you don't need to code, but you need to confidently navigate, edit, and publish within a CMS. • Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage a high volume of tasks and requests simultaneously. • A task-oriented, execution-focused mindset — you take ownership of your queue and find satisfaction in getting things done. • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a service-oriented approach to working with advisors and internal partners. • Attention to detail and a careful eye for formatting, consistency, and brand standards. • Ability to work independently, prioritize effectively, and follow established processes while knowing when to escalate. • Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint) or equivalent tools. • A self-starter who thrives in a hybrid work environment and is comfortable collaborating virtually and in person. Nice-to-have • Experience in the financial services industry, particularly within wealth management. • Familiarity with SEO best practices and tools (e.g., Google Search Console, keyword research tools). • Experience managing a shared inbox or service desk environment. • Project management experience, including tracking tools such as Asana, Jira, or similar platfo
